cost_leadership.title: Supply chain integration (RHP report)
cost_leadership.body: Closed-loop / backward-integrated circular model: the Company runs in-house procurement of waste material, sorting, recycling and production, converting end-of-life energy storage products (used lead-acid batteries) and non-ferrous scrap into pure lead and lead alloy ingots at a single owned Manufacturing Facility in District Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh (7.61 acres, 104,025 MTPA installed). Backward linkage is through a global sourcing network — raw materials imported from forty-nine (49) countries plus domestic scrap and metal trading firms, dealers and auction platforms, with import purchases rising from 23.05% of total purchases in Fiscal 2023 to 64.73% in Fiscal 2025; MoEFCC licensing requirements for lead scrap imports form a high entry barrier that the Company states it clears through low-emission technology investment and a record of regulatory compliance. Quality is controlled in-house via a testing laboratory aligning output with customer specifications. Forward linkage is through direct supply to lead-acid battery manufacturers and metal customers (the facility is deliberately sited near large battery manufacturers such as Amara Raja Energy & Mobility for short turnaround and lower logistics cost) and near Chennai (150 Kms), Kattupalli (130 Kms) and Ennore (130 Kms) ports for import of raw materials and export of finished products, supported by dedicated bulk storage areas for raw materials and finished products. Price risk across this chain is managed by a board-approved hedging framework: a back-to-back pricing model linking quoted prices to LME at order confirmation for both import and export transactions, and futures/derivative contracts exclusively on the LME, typically covering 60%-100% of exposure through forward contracts, with positions dynamically closed when buyers are confirmed. Planned further integration: converting internally generated plastic scrap/chips into plastic granules and refining/recycling tin and copper waste products on a 5.56-acre site at Menakur (V), Naidupet (M), Tirupati District provisionally allotted by APIIC. Sustainability inputs are integrated into the process — oxygen enrichment during manufacturing to reduce furnace-oil dependence, and green fuel derived from end-of-life tyres in place of coal and oil.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- The top customer contributed 51.22%, 72.42% and 85.73% of revenue from operations (INR 3,804.08 million, INR 3,352.94 million and INR 3,530.33 million) in Fiscals 2025, 2024 and 2023, and the top 5 customers 82.46%, 90.54% and 94.49%. Loss of any of these customers could materially affect business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows.
- INR 2,200.00 million of the INR 3,200.00 million Fresh Issue - the single largest object - is for incremental working capital, indicating a scrap-to-ingot cycle that consumes cash as revenue scales; the fund requirement is based on internal management estimates and has not been appraised by any bank or financial institution.
- Total borrowings rose from INR 809.08 million (FY23) to INR 1,423.60 million (FY24) to INR 1,657.66 million (FY25) versus net worth of only INR 626.01 million in FY25; only INR 220.00 million of Net Proceeds is earmarked for repayment/pre-payment, so most debt remains outstanding post-Offer.
- Lead scrap imports are subject to licensing and stringent MoEFCC compliance; import operations rose from 23.05% in Fiscal 2023 to 64.73% in Fiscal 2025, so any delay or denial of approvals would directly interrupt raw material supply and production.
- All 104,025 MTPA of installed capacity sits at one approximately 7.61-acre facility in Naidupet, District Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh; any disruption there (regulatory, environmental, utility or accident) halts the entire business.
- Revenue and gross margin per ton are tied to lead prices; the Company relies on a hedging mechanism for commodity price risk protection and on MCX benchmark pricing, and a mismatch between scrap purchase cost and ingot realisation would compress the 8.88% EBITDA margin.
- Promoters hold 254,000,000 Equity Shares (99.68%) of the pre-Offer capital and are not the original promoters - control was acquired only under the share purchase agreement dated April 26, 2021, so the operating track record under current ownership is short.
- Industry and market claims - including the leading-player positioning and the 33.15% peer-relative revenue CAGR ranking - are derived from the F&S Report dated September 26, 2025, which was exclusively commissioned and paid for by the Company, and reliance on it carries inherent risks.

commitments.title: Promises (RHP)
commitments.body:
- **Expand installed recycling capacity at the Tirupati Manufacturing Facility from 54,750 MTPA to 104,025 MTPA through continued investment since the Promoters' 2021 acquisition.**
- **Deploy INR 2,200.00 million of the Net Proceeds towards funding the incremental working capital requirement of the Company.**
- **Use INR 220.00 million of the Net Proceeds for repayment and/or pre-payment, in full or in part, of certain borrowings availed by the Company.**
- **Raise up to INR 3,200.00 million through the Fresh Issue of Equity Shares of face value INR 2 each, alongside an Offer for Sale of up to 37,650,000 Equity Shares by the Promoter Selling Shareholders.**
- **Cap the amount utilised for general corporate purposes at 25% of the Gross Proceeds in accordance with the SEBI ICDR Regulations.**
- **Complete the pending application with the London Metal Exchange to list the Company's product under 'Ardee Lead 9997', to establish international credibility and global price benchmarking (the brand 'Ardee' is already listed on MCX).**
- **Grow international sales from the port-proximate Tirupati facility, building on exports to seven countries and a 37.03% export share of revenue from operations in Fiscal 2025.**
- **Continue substituting fossil inputs in manufacturing - incorporating oxygen to reduce furnace oil dependence and using green fuel derived from end-of-life tyres in place of coal and oil - to enhance productivity and optimise costs.**
- **Maintain customisable product purity levels of 99.97% to 99.985% conforming to international standards, supported by an in-house testing laboratory and ISO 9001:2015 / 14001:2015 / 45001:2018 accreditations.**
- **Sustain the improving gross margin per ton, which rose from INR 19,511.95 in Fiscal 2023 to INR 29,466.73 in Fiscal 2024 and INR 33,642.16 in Fiscal 2025.**
- **Management flags dependence on its top customer and top 5 customers - 51.22% and 82.46% of Fiscal 2025 revenue from operations - and warns that losing any of them would materially hurt the business.**
- **Continued uninterrupted operations depend on timely MoEFCC licences for lead scrap imports, which have risen from 23.05% of import operations in Fiscal 2023 to 64.73% in Fiscal 2025.**

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:

- Complete the London Metal Exchange listing under 'Ardee Lead 9997' to establish international credibility and global price benchmarking, complementing the existing MCX listing
- Grow the export franchise from the Tirupati facility's port proximity, building on presence in seven countries as of March 31, 2025
